plan.name: Enable configured repository plumbing
plan.summary: Complete #742 in one plumbing pull request by admitting external GitHub plumbing issues only when a valid repository contract and a gate with repository, scope and ratification checks are committed on the authoritative base, replacing the existing blanket refusal and its pinned tests while preserving Invariant's unconfigured runner, modeled builds, supported languages and hosts, hashes, locks and proved protocol. Resolve the committed base once for planning, carry its snapshot through request-local context into the real formalizer and plumbing builder without mutating shared runners, and recover that original authority from the plan's execution base for revisions, ratification, builds, fallback, repairs and read-only reviews; retain captured commands, dependency preparation and cache, rules, documents, native identities and trust, share committed-base and gate validation with watcher preflight and configure its dependency cache and platform, never force configured requests to Go, and validate the ratified execution digest against both its capture and the current base, retaining the captured gate authority including its Invariant commit pin, before ratification, building, readiness and checked-head merge, allowing compatible base movement but handing changed or missing authority or gate capabilities to a person without silently choosing new checks. Keep missing base configuration unsupported with one actionable setup response and the human-review label on intake and revision, with no agent run or proposal/build branch even across repeated polls or branch/workspace-only configuration, distinguish malformed configuration and obsolete or missing gates, refuse out-of-plan publication, derive human holds from actual changes including deletions under captured policy, keep successful trusted changes as drafts through recovery and retries, and preserve durable workflow-credential handoff with no repeated write or rebuild until explicit retry resumes the recorded publication. Add end-to-end Go, Python, Vitest, Jest and Go/TypeScript fixtures using the real planner check, hash ratification, plumbing.Builder, default native adapters, review, scope and publication with stand-ins only at agent, GitHub and container boundaries, verifying base failures and candidate passes, locked preparation and cache reuse, install-only network, offline checks, touched-part selection, captured context, repair and fallback, refusal, recovery and retry behavior; run the relevant existing factory plumbing, scope, ratification, setup, configured execution and compatibility suites and the required repository checks. Update SPEC.md with cited existing grounds and README.md within 400 lines, docs/factory.md and the linked workflow-credential guidance, plus init and agent prompts, to describe enabled configured intake, setup examples, the contract, native tests, captured trust, human holds and no-file behavior; removing D-0121's temporary restriction needs a new decision recorded by the merger with invariant decisions decide before further work, and this plumbing build must not edit decisions/.

tests.name: TestConfiguredFactoryNativeFlow742
tests.says: Configured Go, Python, Vitest and Jest issues use real planning and builder checks, pinned hashes and sources, locked cached installation and offline native execution, then publish an in-scope ready PR and merge only the checked head.

tests.name: TestConfiguredFactoryMonorepo742
tests.says: A Go/TypeScript repository prepares and checks only the touched part while planning, building and publishing its change.

tests.name: TestConfiguredFactoryRevisionAndRepairs742
tests.says: Revisions, fallback and review repairs retain the original captured guidance and execution authority, reuse dependencies, and require fresh checks and approval.

tests.name: TestConfiguredFactoryScopeAndTrust742
tests.says: Candidate policy and out-of-plan edits cannot weaken authority, and explicitly planned repository, CI and agent-rule changes including deletions stay drafts for a person through recovery and retry.

tests.name: TestConfiguredFactoryCredentialRecovery742
tests.says: A workflow push credential refusal durably keeps the successful real build, stops repeated writes, and resumes publication without rebuilding only after a writer's retry.

tests.name: TestConfiguredFactoryRevalidatesAuthority742
tests.says: Changed or removed committed configuration or required gate blocks stale ratification, build, readiness and merge for a person, while compatible base movement preserves the captured identity.

tests.name: TestConfiguredFactorySetupFailures742
tests.says: Missing configuration on intake and revision remains unsupported with actionable setup guidance and no run or branch; malformed configuration and absent or obsolete gates receive specific setup failures, and non-base configuration cannot enable intake.
